reviews.text: They've helped us with our big little Dobby's behavior. We still have a way to go, but they've given us guidelines that have greatly improved his habits and our relationship. And we also have the peace of mind of knowing we can count on them anytime. Thanks, Victor.

Victor has been an excellent companion and instructor. His classes are not only enjoyable, but you also leave learning and with tools to improve your dog's well-being and the overall experience. Fee is equally impressive. She is an attentive and patient trainer who knows how to guide you effectively when addressing your dog's needs through accessible activities for anyone willing to participate.

Taquito and Frijolito were with Lina and we couldn't be happier. They adore her. She has taught us how to communicate and calm down, making living with cats ideal. We would definitely choose her a thousand times over.

We found Can is Cool through a recommendation, and after this wonderful experience, I highly recommend it.

We've spent three months learning together with our pet, and we're still applying everything we learned in class. As a family, we've developed an incredible understanding and synergy!

All the staff are very professional, well-trained, and above all, very patient with our pet and with us, since we're the first ones who have to learn what it's like to have a pet at home.

We are so grateful for all the support and materials provided. We're so happy to be part of the Can is Cool family!

Nala was our first dog as a couple, so when she came home, we were incredibly excited, but also had quite a few doubts and uncertainties about how to best care for and train her. From the moment we contacted Can is Cool, we felt a special connection. They were always available to help us, answer our questions, and support us every step of the way.

Nala was a somewhat timid puppy, which is perfectly normal since everything was new to her. Thanks to the training classes, she learned to interact better with other dogs, gain confidence, and understand boundaries in a positive way. Furthermore, her behavior at home was much easier and more pleasant than we had imagined. Each session provided us with practical tools and tips that we could apply in our daily lives.

The home visit was also a great help, as it allowed us to better understand Nala's needs and discover small changes that could improve her well-being and our relationship with her. The experience and the tricks they taught us made us feel much more confident in this adventure.

The experience was so positive that when we decided to expand our family by adopting Simba, we had no doubt that we wanted to continue with them. Thanks to everything we learned with Nala, we faced this new stage with more confidence and peace of mind. Watching Nala and Simba grow up together has been a beautiful experience, and part of that is due to the support and guidance we've received from day one.
After visiting several places, this one won me over because of the service. My friend told me about it, and he was right.

We've had a wonderful experience with Can is Cool. We've been working with them for two months, and our mini Malinois has truly improved. We noticed changes from day one, both at home and on walks.
Víctor and Fee have helped us with patience and good humor, and they're incredibly kind and affectionate with the dogs.
I highly recommend them. It's a significant investment, but it's well worth the effort, and the course is very comprehensive, with classes focused on all aspects that can help an anxious, reactive, or anxious dog improve. I can only express my gratitude for their help and the care they've given us.

We are super happy with the school and especially with our trainer Liliana!!! She has helped us a lot to understand our dog and be able to give him everything he needs :) we would have liked to go to the group classes more but we couldn't.

Today was my last day at Can is Cool. A huge thank you to Liliana, Ana, Fin, and Víctor. The four of you have helped me understand Cliff better. You've given me the tools to continue training him and to keep going together on this journey that began four months ago when Cliff joined our family. Thank you so much.

The trainers are expert, caring, and dedicated, and they're available to help you throughout the learning process. The classes cover the main aspects so you can acquire the tools to teach your puppy social skills and make it easy for them to go everywhere with you. I would especially highlight the support they provide throughout the training, with online consultations and personalized attention. Bròd has learned a lot and had a great time!

Roma arrived with many difficulties staying home alone, as well as fears about being outside. From the very beginning, Can Is Cool has helped us with these problems, offering their knowledge, guidance, and support.

She has been very happy going to school and loves the teachers dearly. They have dedicated themselves to helping us with a care that shows this is their true calling, not just their job. I am very grateful to them.

We started working with Victor on our dog Musclo's fears and anxieties a month and a half ago. We have in-home sessions to work in his everyday environment, and we're very happy with the progress he's making. We want to highlight the many fun activities we're using and Victor's enthusiasm during the sessions. Musclo has a great time, and in this short time, we're getting to know his needs better and how to support him. The change is already noticeable, and we're eager to continue working together.

We had a great experience with Can Is Cool. Liliana helped us train our 8-month-old adopted dog, and the high-level personalised support made a real difference.

She came to our home to work with us on the specific challenges we were facing, including helping our dog settle in with our cats and adapt to living with other housemates. The guidance was practical, tailored to our situation, and easy to apply.

Liliana is very knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely cares about both the dogs and their owners. Also, our dog loved her. Thanks to her support, we feel much more confident, and our dog has settled into his new home really well.

As well as the individual sessions, we attended some group classes, which were a great opportunity to work on our dog's behaviour and interactions with other dogs.

We can genuinely recommend Can Is Cool. The support we received made a real difference for both our dog and us.

Our experience at Caniscool has been exceptional. We only have words of gratitude for all the staff and, especially, for Liliana, who taught the course with impressive professionalism and expertise.

When we started the classes, Riot was a nervous and very active puppy who chewed on everything. After the course, he has become a well-balanced, obedient, and incredibly affectionate dog with a strong bond with the family. Being able to take him for a leisurely walk or to a restaurant seemed like an impossible dream, and after three months, that dream has come true. We take him everywhere and can enjoy spending time with him in all situations.

Thank you so much for your help and dedication!
Jordi, Montserrat, and Riot

We are thrilled with our experience at Can Is Cool. They have helped us immensely in understanding our puppy and training her to be calm and balanced. The problems we had when we arrived are gone, thanks to their classes and advice. They are a very caring and dedicated team, always willing to help and address any issues that arise in a positive and effective way. The program is so comprehensive that it's clear they have considered every detail and every stage of a dog's life. It includes regular training classes, online classes for important milestones, online sessions for questions and problems that may arise, walking classes, socialization classes, and skills training so that your dog can acquire all the necessary knowledge for her daily life, and above all, for you. Because, most importantly for us, they teach you how to do things and understand each stage of your dog's life and how to handle it. Helping us understand our dog, her behavior, and how she acts in every situation has made all the difference compared to other dogs we've had. Now we understand many things that we didn't understand before, or that we misunderstood. We're still finishing module 3, but we already know 100% that Can is Cool is the best decision we've made recently, as our dog's breed was making things difficult. So, if you notice any behavioral problems in your puppy or feel overwhelmed at any point, don't hesitate to contact them. They'll do an online consultation first to assess the situation, and I assure you they'll help you with everything you need. It's worth every penny. Thanks to the whole team! 💜

We just finished two modules with our puppy at Can is Cool. We loved the experience; we learned not only how to train our puppy but also how to help him understand himself and us. Our teacher, Anna, is fantastic; you can tell she loves what she does. She's attentive to everything and has resources for every situation. The home visit with Lina was also incredibly beneficial, and we were thrilled with her. In addition, the online materials and support channel are super helpful for everyday questions.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts ♥️🐕

We started with our 5-month-old puppy, and he was already quite well-behaved, but he had some specific issues that we didn't know how to resolve or how to guide him so he had the tools to better manage his instincts and emotions.
We attended classes with Ana, who is incredibly kind, always patient and relaxed. She gave us excellent advice specifically for our puppy and takes the time to work with each person/dog individually so that everyone has the opportunity to learn in a sustainable and progressive way.

I've had the opportunity to see firsthand how the Can Is Cool team works, and something struck me from the start: the genuine human touch of the people involved in the project.

Beyond technical knowledge or experience, you can sense a real concern for every dog ​​that walks through the door. They don't work with one-size-fits-all solutions or quick fixes, but rather try to understand each animal's individual needs and adapt their approach to what they truly require.

I also really appreciate their educational approach. It's not just about achieving training goals or improving specific behaviors, but about doing so while respecting each dog's pace, emotions, and abilities. Well-being never seems to take a backseat; it's an integral part of the learning process itself.

Something I particularly value is the consistency between words and actions. There's a constant commitment to helping dogs develop in a balanced way, working on both training and emotional management, always with respect and understanding.

In a field often dominated by fads, miracle cures, and simplistic solutions, it's refreshing to find professionals who focus on the dog as an individual and understand that behind every behavior lies a story that deserves to be heard.

Without a doubt, this is a project built by dedicated individuals with sensitivity, expertise, and a genuine desire to do things right.

When Pili arrived home at just two months old, we felt overwhelmed and unable to understand her behavior: why she chewed everything, had sudden fits of rage, and left our hands in terrible shape. All of this led us to seek a solution. We had a completely distorted image of a "dog trainer," as we imagined physical punishment, yelling, confinement... At Can is Cool, we've realized that training a dog begins with educating the owners and understanding and managing the puppy's behavior. In our experience, this has been the best investment we could have made for Pili and ourselves. We want to highlight the incredible work of Anna and, in particular, Liliana, the trainer who came to our home and gave us the initial guidelines. We are grateful to Zophia, the center's director, for meeting with us and advising us on the best plan to correct Pili's behavior. From our perspective, we have achieved our goal, always with the support of the Can is Cool team. It's been a team effort, as they emphasize dedication at home and every day to achieve good results. I highly recommend this experience. Thank you so much, Pili, Gabriela, and Martí.

Fantastic! Bella has been trained with Can is Cool, which I highly recommend. They offer group classes with other dogs and their owners, all eager to learn and train.
They also offer private lessons, in my case at home. Both Bella and I learned how to live together peacefully thanks to Lina, "Bella's teacher." There are also online classes where we can each ask questions about specific behaviors and learn a lot, especially about managing situations we might not have considered due to our individual circumstances.
In my case, I also use an electric wheelchair, and Bella and I needed to know how to manage walks and how to behave on a patio or in a shop.
In short, everything has gone wonderfully, and Bella knows how to behave.

We went to Can Is Cool when our puppy was in his early teens, completely lost and unsure how to understand him or make ourselves understood. For us, the experience has been very enriching in terms of understanding our dog's character and learning how to channel his considerable energy. Even so, we ended up with mixed feelings for several reasons:
- Firstly, out of 12 sessions, we rarely had the same instructor for more than 2 or 3 consecutive classes; every few classes, the instructor changed. This, combined with the apparent lack of communication between them, gave us a sense of being out of control, as they never knew what we had and hadn't worked on with the dogs. We kept repeating things we had already done and missed out on other things that, for us, were important to have learned.

- The facility seems very poorly suited for working with puppies. It's a rocky area that, for nervous dogs like mine, was completely maddening. The stimulating environment, filled with other equally nervous dogs, caused my dog ​​to constantly try to eat the rocks. I should mention that this was one of the problems we tried to address at the training center, and none of the instructors knew how to help us improve the situation. In fact, we couldn't attend the last two classes (which we had already paid for) because the dog got sick from eating so many rocks, and on top of that, we had to cover the vet bills. The school never contacted us to inquire about our absence.

The package we chose included a home visit, which was very important to us for working on our dog's coexistence with other residents in the building. However, we were required to come to the training center in person. At no point were we told that this session was a substitute for the home visit. My surprise was immense when, upon inquiring about the home visit some time later, I was informed that I wasn't entitled to it because we had already had an individual session at the center, but that I could, of course, pay for it separately for around €70. I find this to be a terrible management tactic on the part of the center and a very opaque practice, simply to avoid the expense of traveling to a home.

In short, the instructors (all of them wonderful) are what saves the center, because everything related to organization and transparency towards families seems to leave much to be desired. If you have a nervous dog, you'll have a very difficult time during the sessions because the classes are very overstimulating and the dogs become extremely agitated, to the point where you can't work with them at all and can simply focus on making sure the poor animal doesn't devour the center's supply of stones.

A wonderful experience. We felt very supported by all the staff who work and collaborate at the school, from Zofia and Liliana to the other collaborators who made the classes fun and useful. They gave us tools to improve our relationship with our dogs at a crucial stage.
A special thank you to Liliana for all the knowledge she shared with us, the calm and expertise she conveyed, and her kind and caring treatment of both the dogs and their owners. A true professional and a wonderful person. 100% recommended.

I started classes at Can is Cool with my 2-month-old Rottweiler puppy, so I started from scratch. The experience is excellent. We began by working on everyday things like recognizing his name and coming when called, and from there, he gradually learned more and more things I never thought I'd be able to do with my puppy. He's now 5 months old, and I'm still working with him at the school and learning more every day. And of course, I have to mention Liliana, the instructor assigned to me. She's a true professional and a wonderful person with a real gift for working with dogs.

When he was a month and a half old, we decided to start his training. We found this place and loved how welcoming and personalized it became.

We finished Biorn's training two weeks ago and we're very, very happy with the results. Of course, he still has a lot of work to do, but they've given us all the guidelines we need to keep progressing.

A huge thank you to Ulph, who has been with us every step of the way, making the learning process as smooth as possible.

Thanks also to Zofia for all her advice and for leading his weekly socialization sessions. She's made Biorn super sociable and taught him to stop and back off when things get tough.

Thank you so much for everything, Biorn says hello!

Before starting Can is Cool, we were incredibly excited about Mia's arrival home, but we also had many doubts about how to train her properly and get it right from the start.
We wanted to understand her and help her grow up well-balanced, but we didn't always know how to handle certain everyday situations. For example, on walks, being a puppy, she wanted to play with every dog ​​she saw, but she approached them very intensely and energetically.
This sometimes caused conflicts with other dogs.
Today, we've resolved that issue, and it's a joy to walk with Mia and see how she approaches and greets all the dogs politely.
What we value and appreciate most about the Can is Cool method is that we've learned to understand our dog. It's not just about teaching commands, but about learning to communicate with her, respecting her pace, and building a relationship based on trust and positive reinforcement. We've felt supported every step of the way, learning as much as, or even more than, Mia.
The progress we're seeing is enormous. Mia is becoming more confident, calmer, and more connected with us. She manages stimuli much better, responds more attentively, and above all, we see her happy learning. It has been very rewarding for us to see her progress and feel that we are creating a solid foundation for her whole life.

We can only thank the team for their professionalism, warmth, and dedication. You can tell when someone works with true passion. It's been a wonderful experience for the whole family.

With Bruno, we mainly had a problem with noise (firecrackers, etc.). When Anna arrived, Bruno improved on walks, which, although not bad, can always be improved. We've gradually improved with the noise; now we're more focused on that issue, and our furry friend is much calmer during football matches. Little by little, with hard work, we're achieving things. We're very happy with the treatment we've received from everyone, and Anna is truly excellent at her job. Thank you so much for helping our furry friend.

We're a couple from Terrassa and we have a West Highland White Terrier. We took a course with MAKA a while back and it was fantastic. After three years, we decided to get a black Miniature Schnauzer, who's now seven months old. And with him came chaos! I mean, he's incredibly energetic, intelligent, and a real whirlwind. He wouldn't stop pulling on the leash and barking at other dogs when we were out walking. We were desperate because we couldn't control him UNTIL we asked Can is Cool for help again. Thanks to Anna, who taught us how to control Moritz, after six sessions everything has changed. Now he walks calmly, doesn't pull on the leash, and everything else is perfect. The most valuable thing about the method is the Can is Cool team; they've surprised us again. The progress has been significant, from obedience to being calm on a terrace. I encourage everyone who loves their pets not to hesitate to contact and try these great professionals. Can is Cool is in Barcelona with excellent facilities, and if you need individual lessons, they're there for you. Thanks to Zofia and her team of professionals who help our pets understand us better, but it doesn't happen alone; you have to be with them and teach them a little bit every day.

The program is fantastic! The trainers are incredibly knowledgeable and super attentive. They answer questions very quickly and have a variety of tips for every situation and every possible problem with our dogs. They gave us special attention and prepared a suitable space so our dog could focus more on the practical classes! We are very happy and believe this program is well worth it! Highly recommended! They're amazing!

We started with absolutely no knowledge of the dog world, and finding Can is Cool was a godsend. Both the director and the staff are exceptional professionals. Special mention goes to Liliana, who has helped us immensely with Chelin through her work, patience with us, and her superb technique. A true professional with an extraordinary vocation. The Can is Cool method has been a fantastic find, and I recommend it wholeheartedly. Thanks to the training provided by the center, and especially by Liliana, my dog, Chelin, has been the solution to the problems one encounters when acquiring a dog. Thank you, Liliana and Can is Cool!

We're very happy with the experience. We have a dog who used to get overwhelmed by children, scooters, and other dogs. Alejandro has helped us have more relaxed walks and manage various situations we didn't know how to handle before. We've noticed a huge difference since we started working with him. From day one, he's been incredibly professional and always attentive to our needs. Now both our furry friend and we can live more peacefully and enjoy our surroundings more.

Special thanks to Alejandro for his dedication and all the training he's given us these past few months!

I'm so happy with the experience and the results!! We came to the academy on a friend's recommendation. We were quite worried about Parkour's behavior and reactivity, as we wanted to be able to have peaceful walks and for our furry friend to feel at peace. Thanks to Can is Cool for giving us a space to work with him, and also for bringing Anna and Alejandro into our lives, who have given us the guidance and tools to manage him according to his breed and personality.

We still have a way to go, but after two months of hard work, I can say that we see great progress in Parkour. His walks and demeanor are more stable, calm, and happy. It has been a learning experience for both him and us, and we are getting to know him better according to his needs and his stage of life. We still have a way to go, but I am so happy with the experience so far. Onward!

I highly recommend Can is Cool! I would definitely do it again.

We arrived with a puppy who was barely two months old. At first, she was super sociable with humans, but she had a lot of trouble with other dogs. Now, thanks to socialization classes with Anna and training with Ulph, we understand her personality much better and have a much better relationship with our puppy.

They are very helpful with the issues that come up daily through their support channel and provide a calm and reassurance that is greatly appreciated.

We are so happy! We arrived with two-month-old Maya (she hadn't even been outside yet!) and they helped us so much with her training. It wasn't just about learning different commands, but also understanding how she communicates with us and how we can help her in different situations, especially with socialization and her behavior in specific moments. In such a short time, she has grown and learned so much 🥹 Thank you all so much, and especially for Ulph's constant support and patience; he has helped us so much!!!

We had little hope for Kara; when we started, it was impossible to walk her. She would pull and eat everything in sight... Thanks to the amazing team at Caniscool and their experience, we've been able to fix that. Thank you so much!

Good morning, my experience with Can is Cool has been wonderful. I have a Cocker Spaniel who, when she turned 10 months old, welcomed a 3-month-old sister of the same breed. Liliana was assigned to us as their trainer, and she got along wonderfully with them. She helped us through the adjustment process and taught us behavioral guidelines. She was always there for us with any questions and has taught us so much: walks, obedience, house rules, etc. My dogs adore Liliana, and she has done a marvelous job with them. I would recommend her 1000%.

Our experience with Anna has been fantastic, truly. Our dog had emotional problems, and we hadn't been able to find anyone to help her until we came across Can is Cool. It was a happy accident, but such a fortunate moment. Our lives, and the life of our Ithaca, began to change with each class, and we still use their methods and advice to this day. I wish we had found them sooner, and this isn't just cheap advertising; it's sincere and honest because thanks to them, our lives, including our little one's, are a thousand times better.

From the first day Alejandro came we noticed a great improvement in our coexistence with our puppy, learning to understand him and knowing how to educate him positively. Alejandro is passionate about the world of dogs and he has passed it on to us. We are very grateful to him and of course we recommend him!!!

Our experience with Alejandro has been unbeatable. We had difficulties and doubts in educating our puppy and with his help we have learned to communicate better and be able to manage certain behaviors. In addition, he has been very close to both us and Lua, and has always been willing to solve any doubt that may arise. 100% recommended

We were very disappointed. The truth is, for the price you pay we expected much more. In fact, we paid and they forgot about us, we had to keep calling and insisting. This method did not work for us and we do not recommend it at all. The only positive thing, and a lot, has been Alejandro, who you can see that he does things out of vocation and with a real commitment with contagious enthusiasm. But otherwise fatal.

Our experience with Can is Cool exceeded our expectations. Dog training, like the training of any living thing, should be handled by dedicated professionals, and we couldn't have been happier when we realized firsthand that Anna is one of the best dog trainers out there.

We had previously consulted other professionals who, while good, lacked the tact, experience, listening skills, and insight that Anna demonstrated in every session. Our dog, or "fur baby" as we like to call him, went from having basic behavioral and aggression issues to being by my side, as I write this, on a dog beach playing and having fun, but above all, following my commands when I need him to.

I 100% recommend Can Is Cool.
Anna 10/10

Four months ago, we took a bit of a leap of faith and decided to expand our family with Rolo, a Belgian Malinois. By two months old, he was already a little firecracker. We quickly realized we needed help. We found Can Is Cool, and it's the best decision we've ever made. They've taught us how to understand Rolo's needs and how to make him the calm, sociable dog he is today—friendly at home and good with people and other dogs.

We're absolutely certain that without their help, this would have been a disaster. All the professionals are excellent: Alejandro, Ana, Ulph, Zofia, and a special mention to Liliana, who we've worked with the most and who has been completely dedicated to Rolo. Rolo has a special bond with her.
We're currently in the final module of their training.

My 5 stars go to Alejandro, our amazing personal trainer! I've had almost no contact with the school due to my schedule, so a million thanks to Alejandro for everything: his patience, his kindness, his love for dogs—he's fantastic!

It's been a couple of months since we finished our time at CanisCool, and we didn't want to miss the opportunity to express our gratitude for everything we experienced and learned there. From day one, the treatment from the entire team has been impeccable: Zofía, the director, exudes a passion and dedication that is evident in every detail; Zaida is always available and attentive to any questions or requests; and the trainers Alejandro, Liliana, and Ana form an exceptional team.

Thanks to them, we have learned so much about dog training, aspects we were completely unfamiliar with, and which have been fundamental in helping our little Íos grow up with a very solid and clear foundation in his behavior.

One of the things we value most about CanisCool is its holistic approach: it's not just about training the dog, but also about training the handlers. They have helped us become aware of the importance of our attitude and behavior, something we often overlook.

We want to give a special mention to Alejandro, who has been most closely involved with Íos, both in group and individual classes. Her approachability, clarity, and confidence made us feel secure at every step of the process. Without a doubt, she has been a key figure throughout this journey.

Alejandro is an incredible instructor, very attentive and knowledgeable about the area. We are so grateful for the change our Brownie has made, both at home and on walks. The school is amazing; they are super attentive and provide the equipment. It's worth every penny. Highly recommended!!!

I'd never had a dog of my own before, and when Freddie came home at almost three months old, I wanted to give him the best possible start. I wanted to learn how to build a good relationship with him, so I started looking for options, and that's when I found Caniscool.

I had a video call with Zofia, the director, who clearly explained the three modules they offer for puppies, each lasting a month. From the very first moment, I liked the personal touch, the structure of the program, and the constant support: WhatsApp support, online materials, Q&A sessions, and, of course, weekly in-person classes with the puppies.

They also offer additional socialization, walking, and skills practice classes every week, which you can attend freely. It's clear that the professionals on the team love what they do; they literally seem to work magic when they teach the puppies, and, most importantly, they also teach us to understand them better.

So far, we've completed two of the three modules and are thrilled with the progress. Freddie knows how to walk calmly, socializes with other dogs, does his business outside, and can stay home alone without any problems. It's not all perfect, of course, but we feel we have the necessary tools to confidently face the coming adolescence.

Taking Vito to dog training school has undoubtedly been one of the best decisions we've made as a family. It's the first time we've had a large breed dog, and we don't regret the investment. But what has truly made the difference hasn't just been the place, but the person who has guided us through this process: Alejandro Bultó.

From day one, he instilled confidence and calm in us, as he has the ability to connect not only with dogs but also with people. He listens, observes, and acts with patience, above all striving to make group training sessions disciplined yet fun.

I would emphasize that Alejandro doesn't just train dogs; he has trained us as a family. He has taught us to understand Vito better and to enjoy our time together even more.

Thank you, Alejandro, for your dedication, your commitment, and for believing in Vito from the very beginning.

I take my Italian Greyhound Zowi to the center and I'm delighted. Alejandro is a true professional; you can tell he knows what he's doing and he connects wonderfully with the dogs. Thank you for everything!

I highly recommend it to anyone with a puppy at home. There's a 1.5-hour class each week where they'll give you all the guidelines for having a well-behaved dog. They're very professional, and if you follow their advice, you'll end up with a perfectly trained pup. Plus, the instructors are lovely!

We are so grateful to Can is Cool for all the help they've given us with Neula, our dog. At first, we didn't know how to train her properly and had many doubts, but since we started with them, everything has improved tremendously. Neula's behavior has changed incredibly, and now she's a much calmer, more obedient, and well-balanced dog. We especially want to thank all the instructors, who have always been so patient and professional!

It's been great working with my pet alongside the Can is Cool team. They have a very helpful and supportive team. The progress I'm seeing with my puppy is fantastic because they give you the tools to continue working at home every day.
I recommend it 100%.
We are very happy with Can is Cool; our dog learned so much with them and there's no comparison to how she behaved before. Thank you so much.
Thank you very much, Anna!
Fantastic school! They have helped me immensely with my puppy's training and understanding his behavior; it wouldn't have been the same without the help of his teachers, all of whom are fantastic.

We've absolutely loved the classes with Can is Cool. We now have much better communication with our dog, and we've learned so much about him, which allows us to live together more harmoniously and makes him happier. We're very grateful to the trainer for his dedication, as well as to Can is Cool for always being there for us and making the whole process so easy. Best regards.

We strongly recommend Alejandro for the following reasons :- 1. He is always very punctual and well organised. If running late due to public transport issues he immediately lets you know. 2. Having worked in the UK he is very fluent in English. 3. Most importantly, he is simply good at his job; a most effective, sympathetic and enthusiastic trainer. We had a number of issues with our puppy which he addressed precisely and purposefully to good effect. 4 His philosophy of working closely with the owners and developing a kind but clearly defined relationship with the dog worked very well for us. 5. Fundamentally he is a responsible, reliable and caring person.
Thanks Alejandro

5 stars⭐ doesn't do justice to all the praise it deserves.

It's been a fantastic discovery, and we're so happy and, above all, absolutely thrilled with the school.

We had just adopted Norman (2.5 months old), and we already had a 10-year-old dog at home. For a moment, we felt overwhelmed, trying to train a little monster who only knew how to bite, disobey, and bother his older sister. Discovering this school was the best decision we ever made. They've given us the tools to know how to train our puppy, but above all, they've helped us understand our puppy and know what to do and how to act in every situation. Norman is still a puppy and a whirlwind, but we now have the necessary guidelines to know what to do when he wants to play, eat, or go for a walk without losing our minds...

We want to thank Alejandro for helping us and giving us the best tools for Norman. He perfectly conveys his professionalism, and you can see the love he has for his work. She makes us enjoy the process, and we will always be grateful to her for everything she has taught us. 🙏🏻😊
